FEAT-2-S118.title: Expose Specialty Identification via Tool Router API
FEAT-2-S118.description: Expose specialty identification as an allowlisted tool through the tool_router, enabling the LLM agent to invoke specialty mapping and receive NUCC codes during conversation flow.

FEAT-2-S119.title: Unit Tests for Specialty Identification Logic
FEAT-2-S119.description: Create unit tests validating regex matching, vector matching, query expansion, and NUCC mapping accuracy within specialty_service, including edge cases for ambiguous and multi-specialty queries.

FEAT-2-S120.title: Integration Test: End-to-End Specialty Mapping in Provider Search Flow
FEAT-2-S120.description: Validate that user input flows from chat → tool_router → find_care_facade → specialty_service and results in correct NUCC codes being applied to provider_search_service queries.
